synonyms: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Evil General in a Hack-and-Slash Game: Destroy the Bad Ending
synopsis: A man works in an exploitative company, and his only joy in life is playing the hack-and-slash game "Brave of Kingdom" when he gets home from work. But one day, when playing the game, he sees something strange, and the next thing he knows, he is inside the world of the game, with the familiar adjutant character Selina before him in her familiar uniform. He has transformed into the game's evil general Zeorg, with his muscular build and full beard, along with his doomed destiny to be mowed down by the game's hero, along with the rest of the game's mooks. Using his survival skills in his exploitative workplace, and his knowledge of the game, Zeorg is determined to avoid a bad ending. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

synopsis: Once upon a time, a Demon King named Rchimedes caused havoc and destruction in the Human World. He was sealed away by the great hero Creasion, and peace returned to the world. 1000 years later, Rchimedes has returned, a hole has opened up in the Human World, and countless monsters have sprung up. title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
titleNative: ミミの怪談
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

titleNative: やまとは恋のまほろば
synonyms: Yamato is a Splendid Place for Love
synopsis: College student Sanwa Honoka is ridiculed by male students for her plump figure. As her best friend gets the most out of college life, her only solace is the Ancient Tomb Study Group, where she can talk about her favorite things, surrounded by two laid-back male members. However, Honoka considers member Iida as a lover at a certain moment. A poetic psychological depiction of how a girl with low self-esteem finds spiritual support and matures. (Source: Japan Media Arts Festival) Note: - A Jury Selection award winner in the Manga Section of the 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival. - Originally published on LINE Manga until it was cancelled on 2020-10-11. The serialization moved to Bunshun Online and new chapters published starting 2022-06-20.

title: LOST MAN
titleNative: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.
